title: Engine 3.0.0 cleanup, email-2FA race, Bearer CSRF bypass, billing salt
summary: 3 of 4 findings fixed. Engine 3.0.0 cleanup removed ~80 duplicate/dead/broken scanner detectors across all 12 check categories. Security fixes: email 2FA code deletion now uses DELETE...RETURNING to prevent parallel-session race; middleware CSRF check reordered before Bearer bypass to prevent fake-Bearer CSRF circumvention (Bearer+no-Origin correctly exempted as true API client); billing verification codes now salted with randomBytes(32) per code. AUDIT-004#audit-01 (admin read audit trail) remains open, low severity, no exploit path.
